text:
Phase 1 (`requirements_analysis`) is complete. The delta requirements have been written to `.sdlc/runs/20261106-120000-feature-extend-lasso-wrap-overlap/requirements.md`.

### Summary of `requirements.md`
- **In scope (1–8) & Out of scope (1–5):** Scoped strictly to making the lasso tool honour `appState.boxSelectionMode` (`"contain"` / Wrap vs `"overlap"` / Overlap), preserving all off-limits files (`App.tsx`, `appState.ts`, `types.ts`, `restore.ts`, `DefaultItems.tsx`, `locales/**`) and keeping any `packages/element` edits strictly additive.
- **Functional Requirements (FR-1 – FR-9):**
  - `FR-1`–`FR-4`: Mode parameter on `getLassoSelectedElementIds`, unchanged Overlap semantics, full real-outline containment in Wrap across rectangles, diamonds, ellipses, rotated shapes, lines/arrows, and freehand strokes, plus bound-text/arrow-label containment.
  - `FR-5`–`FR-6`: `LassoTrail` passes `this.app.state.boxSelectionMode` and enforces Wrap group semantics (all selectable members of a top-level group must be enclosed).
  - `FR-7`–`FR-9`: Additive-only guard on `packages/element`, test suite updates in `lasso.test.tsx` and `selection.test.tsx`, and `CHANGELOG.md` Unreleased entry.
- **Non-Functional Requirements (NFR-1 – NFR-3):** Comparable pointer-move performance via AABB pre-filtering and segment caching, zero new preference/state fields, and strict typecheck compliance.
- **PII Inventory & Role Matrix:** Documented as none / single local interactive editor user.
- **Acceptance Criteria (AC-1 – AC-6):** Mapped directly to the brief's six criteria with executable test file targets and verification commands (`yarn test:typecheck`, `yarn test:code`, `yarn test:app --watch=false`).
